remarks: Discover luxury living in the heart of Westport at 32 Webb Road, a newly built 2026 Colonial offering 8,412 square feet of open-concept living on a private 0.64-acre cul-de-sac lot just minutes from Compo Beach. This exceptional new construction features 8 ensuite with a first floor and 9 bathrooms, including a stunning primary suite with a private balcony, walk-in closet, and spa-like bath. A first floor guest with ensuite bathroomMultiple flexible spaces are ideal for entertaining, working from home, or multi-generational living. The gourmet chef's kitchen is the centerpiece, outfitted with top-of-the-line appliances, custom cabinetry, and seamless flow into sun-filled living and dining areas with soaring ceilings and designer finishes. This property includes a fully approved pool permit, pool already staked out-offering a clear vision for a luxury outdoor oasis. Buyers can move forward immediately, eliminating the uncertainty of approvals-a key advantage in the Westport market. The private backyard is perfect for entertaining and relaxation, with ample space for a resort-style experience. Highlights include custom millwork, high ceilings, natural light, attached garage, and brand-new modern systems. Located 0.5 miles to Compo Beach, moments to downtown Westport's shopping, dining, and Metro-North for easy NYC access..A rare opportunity to own a luxury new construction home in Westport-combining location, scale, and long-term value in one exceptional property.
